mapper.select: SELECT u.*, r.display_name as role_name FROM admin_users u LEFT JOIN admin_roles r ON u.role_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_users (id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, avatar_url, role_id, is_active, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{roleId}, #{isActive}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_users SET email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, role_id = #{roleId}, is_active = #{isActive}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
